profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm a full stack developer with 13+ years of experience, a strong front end foundation, and deep backend expertise. Today I run Quanhex LLC, a Roswell, Georgia software development and IT consulting firm and registered State of Georgia vendor. Quanhex owns and operates every product I build, and it's also how I work with clients.
 
Here's what I've been building:
 
RentingHive is a peer to peer marketplace for renting items locally. It's live, stable, and growing, running on Laravel, Inertia.js, Svelte 5, and PostgreSQL on AWS with metered billing and Stripe Connect payouts.
 
Venue & Crew is a platform for restaurants, breweries, wineries, and event spaces. I built reservations, a drag and drop floor plan builder, and white label custom domains through Cloudflare for SaaS. It taught me an important lesson about product focus, and I'm now refocusing it on what venues need most: booking private events.
 
I'm also building a low cost website platform that gives small businesses fast, professional sites for a few dollars a month, built on Astro, AWS, and Cloudflare.
 
Behind all of it is a multi agent Claude Code workflow with specialized agents for frontend, backend, architecture, and legal work. I direct AI to build rather than compete with it, which lets a small shop ship like a much larger team.
 
Before Quanhex, I spent over a decade building production software across nonprofits, SaaS platforms, media, and healthcare, working in lean agile squads and engineering orgs of 16+ people. On the front end, that means React, Vue, Angular, and Svelte, SPAs and server rendered apps, GraphQL and REST, and Figma to code. On the back end, I've built and maintained .NET services with C#, FastEndpoints, Entity Framework, and SQL Server, alongside Laravel and PHP. I'm as comfortable designing a database schema as I am polishing a micro interaction.
 
I'm open to full time roles and contract work. Whether you need someone to jump into your codebase for a project or a senior engineer to join your team, let's talk. Learn more at quanhex.com.

positions.title: Founder & Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Quanhex is a software development and IT consulting firm and a registered State of Georgia vendor. Every product I build is owned and operated by Quanhex, and I take on client work for teams that need senior engineering without a full time hire.
 
Software Consulting
 Need something done in your codebase but don't want to hire someone full time? I have 13+ years of full stack experience and can jump into most projects quickly: Laravel, Svelte, TypeScript, AWS, Cloudflare, Stripe, and AI assisted development.
 
Products
 
RentingHive (live)
 A peer to peer marketplace for renting items locally, with a growing user base.
 
Laravel, Inertia, Svelte 5, and PostgreSQL on AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS, S3) with GitHub Actions CI/CD
Metered daily billing, sliding platform fees, and handoff and return confirmation flows
Affiliate program with Stripe Connect payouts
 
Low cost website platform (in development)
 Building Venue & Crew showed me how easy it is to launch and host sites for others. This platform gives small businesses fast, accessible, CDN backed websites for a few dollars a month, built on Astro, AWS, and Cloudflare.
 
Venue & Crew (paused, being refocused)
 A venue platform for restaurants, breweries, wineries, and event spaces.
 
Laravel, Inertia, Svelte 5, Stripe Connect, and Cloudflare for SaaS custom domains
Drag and drop layout builder, live hostess dashboard, and a booking widget that prevents double bookings
 The lesson: I drifted toward building a full POS, a market dominated by companies that are their own payment processors. The next version returns to the original mission: helping venues book private events.
 
How I Work
 I pair years of engineering experience with a multi agent Claude Code setup (frontend, backend, architecture, PM, and legal agents) so a small shop ships like a much larger team.
positions.insights: Skills: Anthropic Claude · System Architecture · Entrepreneurship · Software Development · Software as a Service (SaaS)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
At Hilton Grand Vacations, I built and maintained full-stack web applications supporting the company's digital presence and customer experiences using Angular, .NET Core, and Contentful CMS.

	•	Designed and implemented content models in Contentful CMS, architecting flexible structures to support marketing content, product information, and dynamic page layouts across multiple properties.

	•	Maintained and evolved content model schemas in Contentful, adapting to changing business requirements and optimizing for editorial workflows.

	•	Built RESTful middleware services using .NET Core to securely connect the Angular frontend to Contentful and third-party vendor APIs, abstracting API key management and creating a unified data layer.

	•	Developed Angular-based user interfaces that consumed the .NET middleware, delivering responsive and performant experiences for customers exploring vacation ownership options.

	•	Collaborated with content teams, designers, and stakeholders to ensure the platform supported both technical requirements and business goals.

This role strengthened my ability to work across the full stack while integrating headless CMS architecture into enterprise-level applications.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a core developer at BiblioNexus, a nonprofit startup focused on eradicating Bible poverty, I played a pivotal role in architecting and delivering a multilingual content management system designed to support Bible translation efforts around the world.

	•	Full-stack development using C#, .NET, FastEndpoints, Entity Framework, Dapper, and SQL Server on the backend.

	•	Built modern, performant UIs with Svelte 5, SvelteKit, Tailwind CSS, and TypeScript on the frontend.

	•	Integrated ChatGPT to assist in the translation of Bible translation resources into 14+ languages, dramatically increasing reach and accessibility.

	•	Developed a robust Open API to securely expose translation resources to third parties and partners.

	•	Designed and delivered a reference application demonstrating how this open data could be leveraged by organizations working in global ministry and linguistic research.

	•	Prioritized clean code, testability, and scalable architecture in a fully remote, agile development environment.

Unfortunately, BiblioNexus will cease operations due to funding constraints on June 30, 2025. I’m incredibly proud of the work we accomplished and the tools we built to support translation teams around the globe.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · C# · Content Management Systems (CMS) · Web Development · Software Development · Node · Svelte · NPM · SQL · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · Pair Programming · ChatGPT · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · .NET Framework · Version Control · Git

positions.title: UI Developer
positions.description:
At Wellstart Health Systems, I contributed to the development of a headless CRM platform powering a doctor scheduling experience similar to Zocdoc. Our goal was to streamline how patients discover and book appointments with healthcare providers.

	•	Built and maintained backend services using C# MVC, contributing to a robust, scalable, headless CRM architecture.

	•	Developed single-page applications (SPAs) and server-side rendered (SSR) interfaces using Vue.js, delivering fast and responsive user experiences across devices.

	•	Collaborated cross-functionally with designers, PMs, and QA to deliver user-focused features in an agile development environment.

	•	Implemented dynamic scheduling logic, availability filtering, and calendar integrations to support real-time provider availability.

	•	Focused on maintainable, testable code and continuous improvements in performance and accessibility.

This role helped sharpen my ability to build seamless frontend/backend integrations and scale complex scheduling workflows for a healthcare-first user base.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · C# · Content Management Systems (CMS) · React · Web Development · Software Development · Node · Vue · NPM · SQL · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · Pair Programming · ChatGPT · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · .NET Framework · Version Control · Git

positions.title: Developer III
positions.description:
As part of the AJC digital team, I helped build and maintain high-traffic news platforms like AJC.com and DawgNation.com, delivering performant and SEO-optimized user experiences using server-side React.

	•	Developed server-rendered React applications to power the AJC and DawgNation websites, with a focus on core web vitals, SEO, and content delivery at scale.

	•	Built and maintained internal admin tools and editorial dashboards using vanilla React for site editors, journalists, and content producers.

	•	Worked extensively with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Redux, Tailwind CSS, GraphQL, Node.js, and Express to create performant, modern web experiences.

	•	Integrated with Arc XP, The Washington Post’s headless CMS, to support editorial workflows and real-time content updates.

	•	Collaborated closely with design, analytics, and editorial teams to ensure the platform served both business goals and user needs.

This role strengthened my experience working in high-stakes publishing environments and scaling React-based architectures across multiple brands and platforms.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Content Management Systems (CMS) · React · Web Development · Software Development · Node · NPM · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · Pair Programming · Version Control · Git

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description:
At LivePerson, I contributed to the development and maintenance of a real-time chat administration platform used by customer service agents and team managers to manage high-volume conversations efficiently.

	•	Built a single-page application using Vue.js, Vuex, JavaScript, and TypeScript, delivering real-time performance and a smooth user experience.

	•	Consumed and processed WebSocket messages to power live chat functionality, enabling users to handle multiple concurrent conversations, transfers, and queue monitoring.

	•	Created features for management-level users to track conversation metrics, monitor queue times, and view real-time operational statistics.

	•	Worked closely with backend developers and product managers to ensure seamless synchronization of frontend interfaces with chat services and internal APIs.

	•	Focused on usability, responsiveness, and reliability in a fast-paced, high-availability customer support environment.

This experience deepened my understanding of real-time data flow, scalable front-end architecture, and building tools that power mission-critical customer support operations.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Web Development · Software Development · Node · Vue · NPM · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · Pair Programming · Version Control · Git

positions.title: Developer II
positions.description:
At Cox Media Group, I worked on both internal tools and customer-facing digital products that supported audience engagement and subscription growth across CMG’s newspaper properties.

	•	Developed and maintained a white-label membership application using Node.js, React, Redux, and TypeScript, enabling users to sign up, manage accounts, upgrade subscriptions, and access exclusive sponsored deals.

	•	Integrated newsletter opt-ins and paid subscription workflows to support monetization strategies across CMG’s network of media sites.

	•	Collaborated closely with designers in Figma, translating UI/UX concepts into pixel-perfect, responsive interfaces aligned with product goals.

	•	Built and maintained front-end templates for CMG newspaper sites using JavaScript, jQuery, and a Java-based templating engine, working with Methode CMS (Java/Spring).

	•	Worked in close partnership with product managers to ensure business requirements were accurately and efficiently reflected in both the user experience and technical implementation.

This role gave me hands-on experience delivering scalable membership and content systems while collaborating across design, editorial, and engineering teams in a dynamic media environment.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Content Management Systems (CMS) · React · Web Development · Software Development · Node · NPM · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · Pair Programming · Version Control · Git

positions.title: Junior Frontend Developer
positions.description:
At Momentum Telecom, I got my start as a software developer and quickly became the sole front-end engineer responsible for delivering a production-ready single-page application (SPA) for managing cable TV and internet services in small-market ISPs.

	•	Developed and maintained a SaaS web application that enabled providers to provision users, monitor network health, and manage services — powered by a Java Spring backend and SQL Server database.

	•	Built the front-end architecture using AngularJS (1.x), JavaScript, and Bootstrap, collaborating closely with a backend developer to consume REST APIs and deliver a seamless operator experience.

	•	Led front-end development for a customer support tool used by call center agents to diagnose and troubleshoot modem-related issues using real-time diagnostics data.

	•	Gained hands-on experience working in cross-functional teams while building tools that directly improved operational efficiency for telecom service providers.

This role laid the foundation for my career, teaching me how to own an application end-to-end, communicate effectively with backend teams, and deliver value even as a junior member of the organization.

	•	Built a single-page application using Vue.js, Vuex, JavaScript, and TypeScript, delivering real-time performance and a smooth user experience.

	•	Consumed and processed WebSocket messages to power live chat functionality, enabling users to handle multiple concurrent conversations, transfers, and queue monitoring.

	•	Created features for management-level users to track conversation metrics, monitor queue times, and view real-time operational statistics.

	•	Worked closely with backend developers and product managers to ensure seamless synchronization of frontend interfaces with chat services and internal APIs.

	•	Focused on usability, responsiveness, and reliability in a fast-paced, high-availability customer support environment.

This experience deepened my understanding of real-time data flow, scalable front-end architecture, and building tools that power mission-critical customer support operations.

experience.title: Developer II
experience.description:
At Cox Media Group, I worked on both internal tools and customer-facing digital products that supported audience engagement and subscription growth across CMG’s newspaper properties.

	•	Developed and maintained a white-label membership application using Node.js, React, Redux, and TypeScript, enabling users to sign up, manage accounts, upgrade subscriptions, and access exclusive sponsored deals.

	•	Integrated newsletter opt-ins and paid subscription workflows to support monetization strategies across CMG’s network of media sites.

	•	Collaborated closely with designers in Figma, translating UI/UX concepts into pixel-perfect, responsive interfaces aligned with product goals.

	•	Built and maintained front-end templates for CMG newspaper sites using JavaScript, jQuery, and a Java-based templating engine, working with Methode CMS (Java/Spring).

	•	Worked in close partnership with product managers to ensure business requirements were accurately and efficiently reflected in both the user experience and technical implementation.

This role gave me hands-on experience delivering scalable membership and content systems while collaborating across design, editorial, and engineering teams in a dynamic media environment.

experience.title: Junior Frontend Developer
experience.description:
At Momentum Telecom, I got my start as a software developer and quickly became the sole front-end engineer responsible for delivering a production-ready single-page application (SPA) for managing cable TV and internet services in small-market ISPs.

	•	Developed and maintained a SaaS web application that enabled providers to provision users, monitor network health, and manage services — powered by a Java Spring backend and SQL Server database.

	•	Built the front-end architecture using AngularJS (1.x), JavaScript, and Bootstrap, collaborating closely with a backend developer to consume REST APIs and deliver a seamless operator experience.

	•	Led front-end development for a customer support tool used by call center agents to diagnose and troubleshoot modem-related issues using real-time diagnostics data.

	•	Gained hands-on experience working in cross-functional teams while building tools that directly improved operational efficiency for telecom service providers.

This role laid the foundation for my career, teaching me how to own an application end-to-end, communicate effectively with backend teams, and deliver value even as a junior member of the organization.
